findings.claim: The licensing entry records 'Hibernate ORM (Apache License 2.0 / LGPL 2.1 for Hibernate)'. The Hibernate ORM version Spring Boot 4.1.2 resolves is 7.x, which was relicensed to the Apache License 2.0 (announced 2025-03-14, applying from the 7.0 betas onward); LGPL 2.1 applies only to the 6.x and earlier lines that this lab never downloads. The same outdated wording appears in spring-boot/relationships-and-transactions/coding-lab/lab.json line 55.
findings.recommendation: Record Hibernate ORM 7 as Apache License 2.0 in both lab.json licensing arrays and drop the LGPL 2.1 mention.
